command.name: ReviewPaper
command.description: Write review comments for the paper in the `paper` directory in the project root directory.

input.item: (Optional) The journal to which this paper is being submitted.

steps.step: Scan all .tex files and `.bib` files in the `paper` directory in the project root directory.
Write review comments for the paper based on the scanned files.

output.item: A brief summary of the paper.
An overall evaluation of the paper.
